envelope.description: Integrate daemon review supervision and durable feedback commits

body.title: Integrate daemon review supervision and durable feedback commits
body.summary: Replace size deadlines in TaskReviewCoordinator with shared task monitor and activity provider mode, including serial attribution. Serialize validation, atomic completed-task persistence and expiry; accept durable results before wrapper cleanup, retain incomplete work honestly, and check provider capability before admission writes.
acceptanceChecks: Progressing tasks survive former S/M/L limits; one current-task monitor spans serial attribution/task sessions
Actual inactivity cancels owned subprocess and records incomplete without repeating completed tasks
Complete candidates pass existing schema/scope/evidence assessment before checkpoint write; receipt/cleanup only after durability
Candidate-then-crash retains committed assessment; invalid/conflicting/unsaved candidate never passes; write failure preserves prior durable history
Attribution candidates cannot become task results; no automatic review retry or old engine fallback

tests.name: Daemon task activity survives old limits; attribution/task session identity; expiry persists incomplete without automatic retry
Durable candidate vs crash/expiry/write failure/conflicting duplicate; validate before commit, receipt after checkpoint and cleanup
